content: Rust vs Go single-static-binary network daemons: Go gives CGO_ENABLED=0 static by default, trivial cross-compile incl. darwin from linux, seconds-fast builds, goroutine-per-connection fits PTY-to-WS pump model; Rust gives GC-free safety, smaller peak memory, musl/cargo-zigbuild needed for static linux, per-platform macOS runners, minutes-long builds with tokio+axum+rustls trees. Both eliminate the ttyd C memory-bug class.
